title: Stage object and compatible local limit comparisons
statement: Let I be a directed preorder, R:I → CommRingCat a system, c a colimit cocone with proof hc, i an index, and t:Z → Spec R_i locally of finite presentation, quasi-compact and quasi-separated. Fix shared derived module categories [def-pc-derived-category] on all schemes and localized open sites. Write Y_l=Z times_{R_i} R_l and X=Z times_{R_i} c.pt. Given j≥i, let U,V be compact opens covering Y_j, and A,B perfect objects [def-pc-perfect-complex] on their open subschemes. Let E be a derived object on X and give isomorphisms from the derived pullbacks of A,B along g_j restricted to U,V to the exact restrictions of E, where g_j:X → Y_j is the canonical base-change map [def-pc-derived-pullback, def-pc-derived-open-restriction-maps]. There exist k≥j, F in D(O_{Y_k}), and opens U',V' covering Y_k such that the derived pullbacks of F along both open inclusions are perfect. There are isomorphisms pU from Lg_k*F restricted to P=g_j inverse U to E restricted to P, and pV over Q=g_j inverse V. Here these last restrictions land on the localized open sites (the overFunctor restrictions). The canonical maps derivedOpenHomRestriction [lem-sc-derived-hom-mayer-vietoris] of pU.hom and pV.hom to P intersection Q agree. No global morphism from Lg_k*F to E is supplied.

proof_origin.note: Lean assembly of the object-gluing and local-perfectness portions of the Tag 09RF two-open step; overlap descent and comparison transport separated as a strict intermediate theorem.

from.place: Tag 09RF two-open induction: the prescribed overlap transition and stage object construction before the global comparison morphism

proof.text: Apply the descended-transition theorem to choose k and the prescribed overlap isomorphism e for the actual pullbacks A′,B′. It supplies compatible local limit comparisons for any realization of this datum, but no stage object.

Set U′=f inverse U and V′=f inverse V. Inverse image preserves sup and top, so these opens cover Yk. Derived pullback preserves perfectness of A′,B′. Invoke derived_open_gluing_objects with e to construct F and local identifications satisfying the transition equation.

For each point of Yk, the cover places it in U′ or V′. Apply local_perfect_of_openRestriction_iso using the corresponding gluing identification and local perfect object to obtain the defining local model witness. Thus F is perfect. Apply derivedPullback_preserve_perfect to each open inclusion to obtain both perfectness assertions. Finally apply the universal realization clause of the descended transition to F,iU,iV and the gluing equation to obtain pU,pV and their overlap equality.

theorem perfect_local_models_stage_comparisons
    {I : Type u} [Preorder I] [IsDirected I (· ≤ ·)]
    (R : I ⥤ CommRingCat.{u}) (c : Cocone R) (hc : IsColimit c)
    (i : I) (Z : Scheme.{u}) (t : Z ⟶ Spec (R.obj i))
    [LocallyOfFinitePresentation t] [QuasiCompact t] [QuasiSeparated t]
    [∀ Z : Scheme.{u},
      HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Z.toRingedSpace))]
    [∀ (Z : Scheme.{u}) (U : Z.Opens),
      HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} ((moduleRings Z.toRingedSpace).over U))]
    (j : I) (hij : i ≤ j)
    :
    let Yj := pullback t (Spec.map (R.map (homOfLE hij)))
    let X := pullback t (Spec.map (c.ι.app i))
    let gj := baseChangeMap t
      (T := Over.mk (Spec.map (R.map (homOfLE hij))))
      (T' := Over.mk (Spec.map (c.ι.app i)))
      (Over.homMk (Spec.map (c.ι.app j))
        (by dsimp; rw [← Spec.map_comp, c.w (homOfLE hij)]))
    ∀ (U V : Yj.Opens) (hcover : U ⊔ V = ⊤)
      (hU : IsCompact (U : Set Yj)) (hV : IsCompact (V : Set Yj))
      (A : schemeDerivedCategory U.toScheme) (B : schemeDerivedCategory V.toScheme)
      (hA : U.toScheme.IsPerfect A) (hB : V.toScheme.IsPerfect B)
      (E : schemeDerivedCategory X)
      (φU : (derivedPullback (gj ∣_ U)).obj A ≅
        (schemeOpenRestriction X (gj ⁻¹ᵁ U)).mapDerivedCategory.obj E)
      (φV : (derivedPullback (gj ∣_ V)).obj B ≅
        (schemeOpenRestriction X (gj ⁻¹ᵁ V)).mapDerivedCategory.obj E),
    ∃ (k : I) (hjk : j ≤ k),
      let g := baseChangeMap t
        (T := Over.mk (Spec.map (R.map (homOfLE (hij.trans hjk)))))
        (T' := Over.mk (Spec.map (c.ι.app i)))
        (Over.homMk (Spec.map (c.ι.app k))
          (by dsimp; rw [← Spec.map_comp, c.w (homOfLE (hij.trans hjk))]))
      ∃ (F : schemeDerivedCategory
          (pullback t (Spec.map (R.map (homOfLE (hij.trans hjk)))))),
        ∃ (U' V' : (pullback t
            (Spec.map (R.map (homOfLE (hij.trans hjk))))).Opens),
          U' ⊔ V' = ⊤ ∧
          U'.toScheme.IsPerfect ((derivedPullback U'.ι).obj F) ∧
          V'.toScheme.IsPerfect ((derivedPullback V'.ι).obj F) ∧
        let P := gj ⁻¹ᵁ U
        let Q := gj ⁻¹ᵁ V
        let L := (derivedPullback g).obj F
        let RU := (SheafOfModules.overFunctor.{u}
          (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace) P).mapDerivedCategory
        let RV := (SheafOfModules.overFunctor.{u}
          (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace) Q).mapDerivedCategory
        ∃ (pU : RU.obj L ≅ RU.obj E) (pV : RV.obj L ≅ RV.obj E),
          derivedOpenHomRestriction X.toRingedSpace
              (homOfLE (show P ⊓ Q ≤ P from inf_le_left)) (E := L) (F := E) pU.hom =
            derivedOpenHomRestriction X.toRingedSpace
              (homOfLE (show P ⊓ Q ≤ Q from inf_le_right)) (E := L) (F := E) pV.hom
